snapshot.text: Three-part system of public hospitals, union-run social insurance funds (obras sociales) and private prepaid plans. The Milei government has cut and merged health bodies, confirmed Argentina's exit from WHO and announced a reform of the health system.

priorities.title: Health system reform and WHO exit
priorities.text: A reform package of the health system, with the withdrawal from WHO confirmed and a review of vaccines and medicines.

priorities.title: Limits on what doctors may prescribe
priorities.text: New rules will limit which medicines doctors can prescribe.

priorities.title: Merging health agencies
priorities.text: The government dissolved a key health body by decree and merged others.
